name: Scytale
summary: Scytale sizes its Build, Scale and Enterprise plans by employee count, from under 150 people to more than 1,000. Its Audit Hub lets buyers work with their auditor and a dedicated compliance expert inside the product. SOC 2 and ISO 27001 are among its frameworks. No prices are published.

evidence.capability: framework templates such as soc 2 and iso 27001

facts.text: The Build plan is for companies under 150 employees, Scale for 150 to 1,000, and Enterprise for more than 1,000.
The Build plan lists automated evidence collection for audit readiness, and the Scale plan lists AI-assisted evidence review.
Scytale says evidence already stored in the platform is pulled automatically into its Audit Hub.
The Audit Hub is described as a central space for communication, requests and approvals with your auditor and a dedicated compliance expert.
Each plan has a Book a demo button, and the pricing page shows no prices and no free trial.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: More than 1,000 employees. Book a demo
